sw242343.name: Permanent Marker
sw242343.description:
Permanent Marker is a potent cross of Biscotti x Jealousy x Sherbet BX, delivering bold flavor with high-impact effects. This indica-leaning hybrid settles in after a few pulls, offering a lifted, creative headspace paired with steady, calming body relaxation.

Its terpene profile blends sweet and sour fruity candy with sharp citrus diesel and pungent spice. The aroma leans gassy and dank with a bright citrus edge.

Dense emerald-green buds feature purple accents, orange hairs, and a frosty layer of amber-tinted trichomes.

sw242346.name: MAC Stomper
sw242346.description:
MAC Stomper is a flavorful cross of MAC x Grape Stomper, delivering rich fruit notes with calming indica effects. This strain settles in gradually, lifting the mood before easing into deep physical relaxation that leans tranquil and sleep-friendly.

Its terpene profile features fresh mixed berries, spicy grape, and hints of sour lemon, rounded out by floral and earthy undertones. The aroma carries a grape-forward richness with subtle spice.

Rounded olive-green buds display purple accents, orange hairs, and a frosty coating of purple-tinted trichomes.

sw242348.name: Purple Octane
sw242348.description:
Purple Octane is a potent phenotype of Hi-Octane, delivering rich flavor with deep indica-driven effects. This strain builds gradually, beginning with a lifted, euphoric headspace before settling into a heavy, full-body relaxation.

Its terpene profile blends sweet grape wine with spicy diesel and peppery undertones, creating a bold, savory-sweet aroma. As the experience deepens, it leans calming and sleepy, making it ideal for evening use.

Dense forest-green buds showcase purple hues, orange hairs, and a thick coating of frosty trichomes.

sw242349.name: Fight Club
sw242349.description:
Fight Club is a balanced hybrid known for its bold character and refined terpene profile. This strain delivers an uplifting cerebral edge paired with smooth, grounded relaxation, making it versatile for both daytime and evening use.

Its aroma leads with bright citrus notes of orange and lemon, layered with subtle herbal and earthy undertones. The flavor follows with tangy grapefruit, light sweetness, and a touch of spice on the finish.

Dense forest-green buds feature purple accents, orange pistils, and a thick coating of frosty trichomes.

sw381984.name: PR Orion 2 pk (0.5 G ea)
sw381984.description: Orion is known as a "drift" strain. It leads with euphoric calm, balancing sweetness and strength for a deep, unhurried high that feels expansive rather than heavy. Orion is profiled as a balanced, uniform hybrid that marries uplifting mental- clarity with subsequent body-high tranquility.

sw451772.name: PR Pineapple Muffin Mini Pre-rolls 5pk (0.5 G ea)
sw451772.description:
Strain info: Blueberry Muffin & Pineapple Trainwreck


These mini pre-rolls are larger than your average mini at half a gram per pre-roll. They come in a glass jar, which is perfect for preserving your remaining pre-rolls after opening.

sw426359.name: PR Golden Goat
sw426359.description:
Hawaiian-Romulan × Island Sweet Skunk

Golden Goat offers bright tropical fruit and citrus layered with earthy herbs and sweet spice. provides a deep body relaxation, soothing stress relief and a calm grounded finish.

sw295680.name: PR Soap
sw295680.description:
The Soap is a vibrant cross of Animal Mints x Kush Mints, delivering bold flavor with an energetic, mood-lifting experience. This sativa-leaning hybrid hits quickly, offering an uplifting headspace paired with light, stimulating body effects.

Its terpene profile blends sour citrus and sweet woody pine with hints of spicy cheese and pungent diesel. The aroma carries a sharp, minty-fuel character with a bright citrus edge.

Oversized mint-green buds feature orange hairs and a thick coating of golden-white trichomes.

sw347758.name: PR GG4
sw347758.description:
GG4, also known as Original Glue, is a potent cross of Chemâ€™s Sister x Sour Dubb x Chocolate Diesel. This indica-leaning hybrid is known for its heavy, full-body relaxation paired with a euphoric cerebral lift that builds gradually.

Its terpene profile features bold chemical diesel notes layered with earthy mocha and subtle spice. As the effects deepen, they lean calming and sedative, making GG4 well-suited for evening use.

Fluffy olive-green buds showcase amber hairs and a thick coating of bright white trichomes.

sw449615.name: PR Runtz
sw449615.description:
Runtz is a balanced cross of Zkittlez x Gelato, celebrated for its candy-like flavor and smooth, full-bodied effects. This hybrid settles in shortly after inhale, offering a calming cerebral lift before easing into deep, soothing body relaxation.

Its terpene profile bursts with tropical citrus, sour berries, and sweet pineapple, finished with a lightly pungent edge. The experience leans euphoric and tranquil, making it ideal for unwinding in the evening.

Dense olive-green buds feature purple undertones, orange hairs, and a frosty coating of crystal trichomes.

sw451776.name: PR Mendo Breath
sw451776.description: OG Kush Breath X Mendo Montage

sw426348.name: PR Wilfunk
sw426348.description:
GMO × Jet Fuel × Wilson

Wilfunk blends sweet lemon, berry and earthy flavors with uplifting, euphoric effects. This balanced hybrid delivers a cheerful head high and smooth body relaxation, perfect for daytime creativity or social sessions.

sw462450.name: PR Purple Lemonade 2 pk (0.5 G ea)
sw462450.description:
Unknown Purple X an unknown Citrus strain with Californian and Afghan lines

Purple Lemonade is an ndica-dominant hybrid strain. Famous for its striking violet-purple buds, bright orange hairs, and sweet citrus-lemon flavor, it delivers an initial mood lift that transitions into deep body relaxation.

sw454614.name: PR Purple Ice Water
sw454614.description:
Ice Cream Cake × Grape Cream Cake

Purple Ice Water features frosty purple buds and rich dessert flavors. This indica-dominant hybrid delivers uplifting euphoria followed by deeply relaxing, sedative effects perfect for evening unwinding.

sw367327.name: PR Medusa 2pk (0.5 G ea)
sw367327.description: Medusa, more commonly referred to as “The Nirvana Strain,” is a hybrid of the cult favorite Misty strain with an unknown sativa to indica ratio. However, it is thought to be evenly balanced due to its powerful combination of sativa and indica effects that complement each other perfectly.

sw291862.name: PR Lit OG
sw291862.description:
Lit OG is a potent cross of Tahoe OG x Runtz, delivering immediate uplift with smooth indica-backed relaxation. This strain opens with a wave of clear-headed euphoria before settling into a calm, body-soothing finish that keeps you comfortably grounded.

Its terpene profile blends sweet, creamy citrus with classic kush, woody pine, and subtle spice. The aroma leans rich and earthy with bright fruit undertones.

Oversized olive-green buds feature purple accents, thick orange hairs, and a frosty coating of crystal trichomes.

sw477144.name: Octane Mintz
sw477144.description: Octane Mintz is a potent indica-dominant strain (70% indica, 30% sativa) born from the flavorful cross of Sunset Octane and Wedding Cake. This strain boasts a rich aroma profile that combines the earthy, diesel notes of Sunset Octane with the sweet, vanilla undertones of Wedding Cake. The result is a deeply relaxing and euphoric high that envelops the mind and body, making it an excellent choice for unwinding after a long day. The effects come on strong, providing a sense of calm and contentment while also stimulating the appetite, often leading to a satisfying case of the munchies. Beyond its recreational appeal, Octane Mintz is also favored for its therapeutic benefits. Its high potency makes it effective for alleviating symptoms of pain, stress, and insomnia. The strain's relaxing nature can help ease tension and promote restful sleep, while its mood-enhancing effects can provide relief from anxiety and stress. Whether you're looking to relax, relieve pain, or simply enjoy a peaceful evening, Octane Mintz offers a well-rounded experience that caters to both the body and mind.

sw477146.name: Killer Cupcake
sw477146.description: Killer Cupcake is a perfectly balanced hybrid (50% indica / 50% sativa) bred from a powerhouse lineage: Killer Queen, Cindy-99, and Ice Cream Cake. Known for its sweetly decadent profile, this strain combines a creamy cupcake flavor with notes of vanilla, lemon citrus, and a subtle kick of diesel. Its rich terpene blend translates into an aroma that’s as inviting as its taste—sugary and smooth, layered with bright citrus and spice. Killer Cupcake delivers both the flavor and the potency to make it a standout on any menu. The effects of Killer Cupcake are equally indulgent, beginning with a euphoric lift that sparks creativity, sociability, and an overall sense of joy. This cerebral high is balanced by a warm, relaxing body sensation that gradually deepens into tranquility, making it as fitting for lively social settings as it is for unwinding at the end of the day. Ideal for easing stress, mood swings, or insomnia, Killer Cupcake is a versatile cultivar that pairs a dessert-like flavor with a therapeutic, full-spectrum experience.

sw477152.name: Cherry Lady Slipper
sw477152.description: Cherry Lady Slipper is a vibrant hybrid cannabis strain that captivates the senses with its sweet, bright fruity aroma and balanced effects. Bursting with notes of ripe cherries, crisp apples, and a hint of sugary candy, this strain delivers a refreshing and inviting terpene profile. Its buds are typically dense and colorful, showcasing shades of deep green and purple with fiery orange hairs and a generous coating of sparkling trichomes. Cherry Lady Slipper offers an uplifting cerebral buzz that promotes positivity, creativity, and a light mental clarity. As the experience deepens, a gentle body relaxation begins to unfold, easing tension without overwhelming sedation. This makes Cherry Lady Slipper a versatile option for both daytime enjoyment and early evening unwinding. Whether you're looking to enhance your mood, spark inspiration, or simply relax without losing focus, Cherry Lady Slipper delivers a smooth, flavorful, and well-rounded high that appeals to a wide range of users.

sw477154.name: GG4
sw477154.description: GG4 is a hybrid weed strain made from a genetic cross between Chem’s Sister, Sour Dubb, and Chocolate Diesel. GG4 is a potent strain that delivers heavy-handed euphoria and relaxation, leaving you feeling “glued” to the couch. Its chunky, resin-covered buds fill the room with pungent earthy and sour aromas inherited from its parent strains. GG4 is 20%+ THC, making this strain an ideal choice for experienced cannabis consumers. GG4 effects include feeling relaxed, sleepy, and hungry. Medical marijuana patients often choose GG4 when dealing with symptoms associated with stress, anxiety, and pain. GG4 features flavors like pungent, pine, and earthy. The dominant terpene of this strain is caryophyllene. GG4 is a multiple award-winning strain that has taken first place in both the Michigan and Los Angeles 2014 Cannabis Cups, as well as the High Times Jamaican World Cup in 2015.

sw480724.name: PR Wilfunk 5pk (0.5 G ea)
sw480724.description:
GMO × Jet Fuel × Wilson

Wilfunk blends sweet lemon, berry and earthy flavors with uplifting, euphoric effects. This balanced hybrid delivers a cheerful head high and smooth body relaxation, perfect for daytime creativity or social sessions.

sw480765.name: PR Watermelon Pound Cake 5pk (0.5 G ea)
sw480765.description:
Watermelon x London Pound Cake x Kush mints

Watermelon Pound Cake is a premium sativa dominant hybrid with a sweet watermelon aroma layered with rich pound cake notes and a cool hint of mint, delivering a smooth, dessert-like flavor that’s both refreshing and indulgently balanced

Gives energetic, euphoric onset that promotes creativity and conversation before settling into a comfortable, relaxed finish

sw480778.name: PR Hawaiian Fanta 5pk (0.5 G ea)
sw480778.description:
Pineapple Fanta x Grape Gasoline

Hawaiian Fanta bursts with zesty tropical fruit and a fuel finish. This sativa-dominant hybrid promotes a mood boosting and motivational, uplifting experience that feels bright, refreshing, and perfect for daytime enjoyment

High CBD strain, motivational, mood boosting effects, and a calm body buzz. Flavored like zesty tropical fruit with a fuel finish
